# Know when your cron jobs silently stop

> Know when a cron job silently stops. Paste your crontab to get next runs, the right grace period and a wrapped line that pings a heartbeat monitor you can self-host with zero dependencies. Free, source available, runs in your browser.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
